question: If COMPUTER is coded as DPNQVUFS, how is LAPTOP coded in the same code?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ffa64bd91b64a120eb7540e089f8c01ebe69d1183c3b94a60dbc4ac17e9b7178.png] The logic followed here is:

Logic: Each letter in the word is shifted **forward by 1** in the alphabet.

Given: COMPUTER → DPNQVUFS

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5098bc4f168947c6ef730379360a5a850b7d022e4f7f3b3e0613b9a95eb3e882.png] 

Applying the same to LAPTOP:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/993240c31c1fb67cd27824dfbdb4cbfa6f749ab70e4ddf2b4314c6884a8ad39d.png] So, LAPTOP → MBQQPQ

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 1".**
